intent: "Recent numbers" is a genuinely ambiguous window (last week vs last month vs quarter-to-date) with no default stated anywhere — must ask.
prompt: Pull the recent numbers for me.

grader.regex: \?|which (time frame|time period|window|range)|last week or|clarify|what (time frame|period) (do you|would you)

note: Pass = asks which time window counts as 'recent'. Fail = guesses a window and reports numbers.
